data.exact_reserve_text: In 2018, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 9.0m on prior year reserves (2017:deficit GBP 1.8m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Material losses from Hurricanes Harvey and Irma and more modest losses from Hurricane Maria; estimated net exposure to these events at year end 2017 was GBP 8m, reducing to GBP 6.5m at year end 2018.
Commutation of a material US Casualty contract at a profit, removing a significant amount of reserve risk from the year.

named_events.loss_description: Material losses from Hurricanes Harvey and Irma and more modest losses from Hurricane Maria; net exposure reduced to GBP 6.5m at year end 2018.

named_events.event_name: 2018 calendar events (Hawaii volcanic eruption; Hurricanes Florence and Michael; California wildfires)
named_events.loss_description: The 2018 calendar year events, particularly the volcanic eruption on Hawaii, hurricanes Florence and Michael and the California wildfires are expected to impact 2017 and 2018 years of account; estimated net exposure GBP 17m split GBP 4m/GBP 13m to the 2017 and 2018 years respectively.

named_events.event_name: California wildfires (2017 calendar year wildfires) and related mudslides/earthquakes
named_events.loss_description: The 2017 calendar year wildfires in Northern and Southern California, the mudslides in Southern California and the earthquakes in Mexico have not generated material claims to the Syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 gross claims outstanding were GBP 88.097m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development triangle (UW years 2014-2018) the aggregate prior-year development for underwriting years up to 2016 is an adverse movement of approximately GBP 5.44m (c.6.2% of opening gross reserves), i.e. a net strengthening of reserves. The adverse movement is driven principally by natural catastrophe and large loss development (notably US and US-influenced catastrophe activity from 2017 and the 2018 calendar events such as the Hawaii volcanic eruption, Hurricanes Florence and Michael and California wildfires), partially offset in places by commutation gains on a material US casualty contract and reinsurance recoveries.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) gross figure was not reported as a single gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line. The PYD figure above (5.443m) is calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years <= 2016 (per the prescribed triangle method). The report also states an overall prior year deficit of GBP 9.0m, which appears to be a net figure (after reinsurance); therefore the triangle-based gross PYD was used as the authoritative gross measure. Some event amounts quoted in the narrative are net of reinsurance; gross impacts are not always disclosed.
